title: Mel Brooks' Young Frankenstein - review
transcript: I guess you'll either love or hate the crude humor of Mel Brooks Young Frankenstein it's carrion style corny jokes about women infatuated with men who are large down below and men who are hypnotized by women who were equally large up top personally loved it Mel Brooks is a comic genius and he knows how to write a stage musical he's a way of creating hilarious characters and then putting some very funny words in their mouths he might seem a relic from the past but the conflict between ego and heed is eternal for example the number don't touch led by Dan Pilkington contrasts hilariously Frankenstein's fiance's prim behavior with a lewd mind all the song and dance numbers are superbly choreographed by the director Susan Stroman the cast may change but you know there's enough meat here for any good performer to get their teeth into nevertheless I have nothing but praise for the current team had they phrased a spot on us the high-minded Frankenstein Lazar Joseph and Roz Noble get lots of love the servants and summer stralla is one of the best musical performers around the stereotypes of men and women are dated but if you can accept that Young Frankenstein is a lot of fun I give it four stars you
